definitions.explanation: An action carried out suddenly and without advance warning, typically an inspection, test, or check. Almost always used as a modifier with の or in compound form.

examples.japanese: {抜|ぬ}き{打|う}ち⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{抜|ぬ}き{打|う}ち⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: An unannounced inspection was carried out.

examples.japanese: {保健所|ほけんじょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{抜|ぬ}き{打|う}ち⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飲食店|いんしょくてん}→飲食店：15093_inshokuten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The health center sometimes inspects restaurants without prior notice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{抜|ぬ}き{打|う}ち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{小|しょう}テスト→小テスト：27557_shoutesuto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
examples.english: The teacher likes giving pop quizzes.

notes:
Originally a kendo term meaning to draw and strike in one motion, {抜|ぬ}き{打|う}ち now primarily refers to doing something without advance notice. It is almost always used as a noun modifier: {抜|ぬ}き{打|う}ち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜 or {抜|ぬ}き{打|う}ち⟦で→で：00502_de⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {抜|ぬ}き{打|う}ち⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧: surprise test; pop quiz
- {抜|ぬ}き{打|う}ち⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧: surprise inspection
- {抜|ぬ}き{打|う}ち⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧: to investigate without notice
- {抜|ぬ}き{打|う}ち⟦{監査|かんさ}→監査：05972_kansa⟧: surprise audit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧: sudden — describes any abrupt event, not specifically planned surprise actions
- ⟦{不意|ふい}→不意：11351_fui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: unexpectedly — focuses on the recipient's lack of awareness
- ⟦{予告|よこく}→予告：08379_yokoku⟧なし: without advance notice — more neutral and explanatory
